appeals.draft:
Re: Appeal of Claim Denial -- Claim Number BMI-2026-0932-HC

Dear Claims Appeals Department,

I am writing to appeal Bedrock Mutual Insurance's decision dated 2026-07-10 on the above claim, which denied coverage for roof damage under the wear and tear exclusion, Policy Section 6.3.

This finding contradicts the independent inspection performed by Highline Roofing & Restoration, licensed contractor report dated 2026-06-25. The inspection found wind-driven granule loss and impact fractures consistent with the June 18, 2026 storm, not gradual wear. I am enclosing that report and ask that the wear-and-tear determination be reversed.

The claim should be reprocessed and paid at the independently estimated repair cost of $18,400.00 under Dwelling Coverage, Policy Section 3.1.

Please reconsider this denial and reverse the wear-and-tear determination in light of the enclosed evidence before the appeal deadline of 2027-02-01.

Sincerely,

Morgan T. Ellis

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
